name: FrenchModelVariant469_HandleRequest

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-452 images build the same source through model_variant/variant452_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the data block 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
